hold_text: Trader-side change in src/runtime/desk_event_trigger.py (Tier-2 by path, R5): a build whose `systemctl start` client was killed with the trader is DETACHED, not failed. No could_not_build label, the in-flight mark stays for the next pass to adopt a finished survivor, and one build at a time is preserved. AM-OPS merges on green guards.
why: DESK-BUILD-DETACHED: with isolation=unit live, every deploy restart SIGTERMs the systemctl client (4 of 5 builds 21:10-21:44Z ended `no result.json (systemctl exit -15)` at a trader stop), the thread labelled could_not_build and cleared the in-flight mark, so survivor adoption (#25356) could never see those builds.
